label: TP
reason: The CodeQL report identifies two vulnerabilities: insecure randomness from java.util.Random (line 101) used for session tokens, which is cryptographically weak, and XSS where user-supplied cookie values (line 114) and names (line 112) are concatenated into HTML output via PrintWriter.println without encoding.

evidence.note: Uses java.util.Random instead of SecureRandom for generating rememberMeKey
PrintWriter outputs user-controlled cookie name/value directly into HTML without encoding
